canonical_project: Amazon Data Services India - Kandukur/Meerkhanpet (Hyderabad Pharma City) campus
owner: Amazon Data Services India Pvt Ltd (AWS)
notes: EC granted Feb 2020 (SIA/TG/MIS/136947/2020) for Data Center at Plot 1, Sy 120, Pharma City, Meerkhanpet (V), Kandukur (M), Ranga Reddy; EC amendment sought 2025-26 (site area/built-up changes).
